newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian bankruptcies up 19 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Canadian bankruptcies up 19 pct in 1996.

text.p: Bankruptcies in Canada rose by 19 percent in 1996 to 78,690 from 65,612, the Department of Consumer and Corporate Affairs said on Friday.
In December bankruptcies rose 23 percent to 7,615 from 6,201 a year earlier. The department said 1,045 businesses and 6,570 consumers went bankrupt in the month.
The December figures were nonetheless down from November, when 8,059 bankruptcies were recorded -- 1,157 businesses and 6,902 consumers.
For 1996 as a whole, the number of business bankruptcies rose to 14,229 from 13,258 in 1995, while consumer bankruptcies rose to 79,631 from 65,432.
